data.explanation: This is a private dental invoice (Privatliquidation) for treatment you received on 28 August 2025. It asks you to pay €197.93 to the dentist's bank account by the deadline shown, which is counted from the invoice date. Pay on time to avoid a payment reminder. Keep the invoice, since dental treatment costs can sometimes be claimed in your tax return as extraordinary expenses (außergewöhnliche Belastungen), especially if not reimbursed by insurance.
